title: totem limit
description: This mod is a lightweight utility for Fabric servers that restricts players to carrying a maximum of 2 Totems for a fair pvp experience.
body:
What does this mod do?

Basically, it puts a hard cap of 2 totems. If a player tries to get a 3rd totem in their inventory whether they pick it up off the ground, pull it out of a chest, or try to "glitch" it in using hotkeys this mod says "no thanks" and spits it back out onto the ground.

To change the text language, just change this line: Text.literal("§c§lTotemlimiet bereikt van 2") to your desired language in src/main/java/com/example/mixin/TotemLimitMixin.java.
